Nell from the Silt Lanes, Tam says, knows more about the forgetting. But not today: the water is rising.

The journey continues to Varrowmouth. From there, there is no way back to the earlier cities.

"Here even empty envelopes count as a beginning."

The clerk slides a slate towards you. It reads: "Please state only what I can actually verify."

You remember both ways.

Nell from the Silt Lanes, Tam says, knows more about forgetting. And at ebb tide the Wreck Field lies dry, beyond the east pier.

The Tide Council sits on the High Street. It will be a while yet before they let you in.

You don't have to prove anything to anyone.

Don't ask for an answer yet.

You cross the marked line. Being cut off by the tide does not count as a victory.

The Tide Council sits on the High Street. This time it will let you in.

Outside, the old beacon blinks on the bank. Tam says she will only sail there once she knows who keeps the light.

Choose the customs councillor as witness.
Choose the harbour councillor as witness.
„Ich widerspreche jeder neu eingetragene: "I will object to every newly entered act at once." The customs councillor takes his stamp with him and leaves his official coat open.

Seven chairs stand on dry parquet.
Beneath two of them lies a thin waterline.
No one moves aside because of it.
Your invitation has already been punched.
A customs official lays his finger on the wrong time.

Die Leiter endet im Wasser. Unten treibe: The ladder ends in the water. Below, crates drift through the lanes and people sit on the roofs, waiting. At ebb tide you can climb down again.
Die Einladung enthält deine heutige Besc: The invitation contains today's description of you, but a receipt stamp from the day before. A second stamp covers only the time.
Im Ausgangsbuch des Zollamts fehlt die N: The number of your summons is missing from the customs office's outgoing ledger. Space was left beside it for a later addition.
Die offizielle Kurve kennt seit vierzig: The official curve has known no storm in forty years. The raw strips beneath it show considerable spikes.
Ein Randvermerk verlangt, jeden Ausschla: A margin note demands that every spike be recalculated to the mean level. The water height did not stay the same by itself.
Auf der Besoldungsliste steht beim Regis: In forty years the payroll shows not one day of sleep or sickness for the registry office. The handwriting never changed either.
Das Siegel des Registeramts drückt durch: The registry office's seal presses through the paper onto the table. The imprint vanishes with the next stroke of the bell.

Wem vertraust du die Übergabe an?: Whom do you trust with the handover?

Der Zollrat räumt ein, die Vorladung zur: The customs councillor admits backdating the summons. That way your entry looks like an order of the council, not Tam's offence.
Der Pegelrat nennt die Glättung schließl: The gauge councillor finally calls the smoothing a protective calculation. A waterline creeps up his fingers without his noticing.

Ein Amt ohne Puls: Beleg 2: An Office Without a Pulse: Evidence 2
Ein Amt ohne Puls: Beleg 3: An Office Without a Pulse: Evidence 3
Der Registerrat kann seine letzte Mahlze: The registry councillor cannot name his last meal. He goes on about pensions as if the gap did not concern him.

Die Flut kommt. Das Wasser steigt so sch: The flood comes. The water rises so fast that the fight ends by itself; whatever attacked you sinks back into the silt.
Gezeitenläufer versinkt zwischen den Pfä: The Tide Strider sinks between the piles.
Ebbe. Das Wasser fällt unter den Stelzen: Ebb tide. The water drops away beneath its stilts, and the thing stalks out to sea before it can be left on dry ground.
Auf langen Stelzen aus Treibholz stakt e: Something stalks across the water on long stilts of driftwood. Wherever it steps, the flood sloshes over the planks.
Springflutläufer versinkt zwischen den P: The Spring Tide Strider sinks between the piles.
Die Flut kommt über das Wrackfeld. Die W: The flood comes over the Wreck Field. The Wreck Mother withdraws into her hull, and Tam pulls you onto the pier. At the next ebb she will be waiting again, whole.
Die Flut steigt in die Schlickgassen. Du: The flood rises into the Silt Lanes. You climb the ladder before the water takes the lowest rungs.
Die Flut kommt über das Wrackfeld. Tam w: The flood comes over the Wreck Field. Tam throws you a rope from the east pier and pulls you up.
Die Flut kommt. Das Wasser steigt in die: The flood comes. The water rises into the lanes.
Ebbe. Das Wasser zieht sich zurück und g: Ebb tide. The water draws back and lays the silt bare.
Die sieben Ämter haben keine gemeinsame:
The seven offices share no common innocence. You choose a witness recorded by name, not a new owner of the city.

Outside, the old beacon flashes on the bank. Tam readies her boat at the jetty of the Customs Harbour.
Ist die Gefangenschaft noch nötig, um di: Is the captivity still needed to hold back the flood?
Osric half bei der Rettung und erkannte: Osric helped with the rescue and later recognised the abuse. The old procedure knows an effective release.
Ein einzelner Schlussklang beendet die A: A single closing toll ends the intake. On its own it does not destroy the coastal defence.
Die Herrschaft beruht auf vermischten Ka: The rule rests on mixed categories. The reading must tell the dead from the living instead of releasing everyone wholesale.
Geordnete Übergabe und Zerstörung haben: An orderly handover and destruction have different consequences. With release the sea comes later; with destruction, at once.
Osrics Verfahren unterscheidet einen geo:
Osric's procedure distinguishes an orderly closing from destruction. You now know both the long coastal defence and the danger of an immediate breach.

Beneath the council building lies the Register Cellar. At low tide you can get down there.
Wer darf die Namen tragen, nachdem Harro: Who may carry the names once Harrow's rule ends?
Ismay Harrow selbst ist das Register. Di: Ismay Harrow herself is the register. The books multiply her bindings, but they do not carry them.
Ein bestätigter Ratszeuge begrenzt Harro: A confirmed council witness limits Harrow's grasp. His former office does not make him the owner of your abilities.
Nells Gabe ist keine automatische Zustim: Nell's gift is no automatic consent. A handover requires her explicit answer and your willingness to stay on as scribe.
Der Sieg entscheidet nicht über das Ende: Victory does not decide the ending. The register choice and a later ascension or renunciation must be confirmed explicitly.
Harrow hat die alleinige Verfügung verlo: Harrow has lost sole command. No victory dictates what you must do with the open line.
Osric trocknet die Tinte zwischen seinen: Osric dries the ink between his fingers. "You want a date. I fear I must give you my hand along with it."
Let us read your first entry.
Kann Vorlesen einen Kampf beenden?: Can reading aloud end a fight?
„Damals strich ich eine Abfahrt durch. D: "Back then I struck out a departure. The person was gone, the entry settled. I took that for granted." You copy the old release formula without removing his margin note.
„Die Toten wurden nicht durch ihre Namen: "The dead were not saved by their names. And the living did not become property through their names." You separate both lists on the table.
„Ich schrieb die Einleitung. Später schr: "I wrote the introduction. Later I wrote warnings and left them here. You may keep both side by side." He lays the unsent letters beside the official pages.
„Ein einzelner Schlag nach dem letzten N: "A single stroke after the last name. Not before, not in its place." You pull the test rope and let the real clapper rest again.
„Nach dem ersten Widerstand kann sie zuh: "After the first resistance she can listen. You need all four proven trails, and you must let me read the differences aloud. A magic word alone will not do it."
Der gewählte Zeuge wartet außerhalb des: The chosen witness waits outside the watermark. Only his explicit promise prepares the protection against being entered.
Remind the Customs Councillor of his promise.
Remind the Harbour Councillor of his promise.
„Ihre Handlung gehört Ihnen. Ich bestrei: "Your action belongs to you. I will contest its entry every single time." He sets his imprint on the dry witness line.
„Die Tür bleibt frei. Und ich sehe, wess: "The door stays free. And I see whose action that was." He sets the escape plan beneath a dry lamp.
Das zerbrochene Linsenrad gibt einen Men: The broken lens wheel releases a person who no longer prepares an attack. You let him live and cover his cold shoulders.
„Vierzig Jahre lang habe ich jeden eintr: "For forty years I held every name that arrived. You call it captivity. Back then it was called rescue." Harrow smooths a line without looking at the wall.
Was wurde aus der Befristung?: What became of the time limit?
„Die erste Nacht endete. Die Bitte nicht: "The first night ended. The request did not." You lay the record before her. Her fingers pause on the missing expiry date.
„Dann treten Sie in die Zeile.“ Das Wass: "Then step into the line." The watermark closes around her hands, not around the exits.
„Sie haben die Schreiber erreicht. Jetzt: "You have reached the scribes. Now you are speaking to the register." Her voice comes from several lines at once. Osric keeps the old book closed until you ask him.
Read the old procedure aloud in full.
Den Sieg im zweiten Abschnitt bestätigen: Confirm the victory in the second section.
Du trittst vor die lebenden Zeilen. Der: You step before the living lines. The council witness, if confirmed, raises his imprint; he can limit her entries, not prevent every grasp.
Osric liest zuerst die Toten, dann die A: Osric reads the dead first, then the departures, and last the powers never granted. You hold the four pieces of evidence beside them. Harrow closes her hand, and the lines stop demanding new names.
Die zweite Zeile reißt nicht, sie wird s: The second line does not tear; it falls silent. Harrow can no longer hold on to a new action. You have ended the resistance, not yet the register.
„Es ist still genug, dass ich Ihre Antwo: "It is quiet enough that I can hear your answer." Harrow leaves the closing line open. "Do not say yes just because you no longer want to fight."
Vier Folgen liegen offen vor dir. Lies s: Four consequences lie open before you. Read them separately; only the second confirmation sets the outcome.
Carry the names: read the consequences.
Destroy the register: read the consequences.
Two hands remain: read the consequences.
Du schließt die Aufnahme und nimmst die: You close the intake and take the names upon yourself. The residents may leave; the sea defence gives them years for new dikes. The way to the Last Register opens, but only its trial decides on Sequence 1.
Du zerstörst die Bindung. Harrow stirbt,: You destroy the binding. Harrow dies, and the dammed-up surge reaches the prepared evacuation. You renounce Sequence 1; the dry exit is a task, not a picture of victory.
Nell übernimmt die Last nach ihrer ausge: Nell takes on the burden after her spoken consent. You stay as her scribe; no warm phrasing turns that into an easy childhood. Sequence 1 remains possible later, once the responsibility is newly and soundly arranged.
Ihr teilt die Last und bindet euch beide: You share the burden and bind yourselves both to Varrowmouth. No one ascends to Sequence 1. You hold the names open together without taking it as permission for new entries.
Am Küchenfenster wartet ein Teller.\nDer:
A plate waits at the kitchen window.
The place on the list is empty.
Nell sets a second spoon beside it.
No one asks whether an empty line can be hungry.
You carry the portion to the dry board.
The steam hangs above the silt for a moment.
Das Seil ist in der Mitte glatt geworden:
The rope has worn smooth in the middle.
Osric holds it below your hand.
The single closing toll is still to come.
In the lamp glass his old face stands beside yours.
A page rustles, though no window is open.
You lay a weight on the right list.
A person sits among the shards.
The hands no longer hold a grip.
You lay a coat over the cold shoulders.
Osric sets the lamp on the floor.
The cone of light now shows the wall instead of a target.
The list of the drowned stays closed.
Hinter dem Zollzaun beginnt der Grenzbez:
Beyond the customs fence the border district begins.
The posts bear ordinary numbers.
The ritual promises no substitute for your decision.
You check your own path and the requirements at hand.
A tide stroke comes from the harbour.
The last stretch stays in this city.
Die erste Schicht der Schrift löst sich:
The first layer of writing comes loose from the water.
Beneath it there are no blank pages.
Harrow looks at your hands.
Osric waits for your request, not for her sign.
The witness keeps his imprint dry.
The next move belongs to you again.
Die Uhr schlägt oben weiter.\nHier unten:
The clock keeps striking above.
Down here no line demands a new entry.
Harrow breathes without producing a copy.
Nell stays on the dry edge.
Tam checked the exits before the decision.
You leave the last line open a while longer.
Das Kapitel ist entschieden.\nDie Mensch:
The chapter is decided.
Not everyone talks about it yet.
One hand tests the next step of the pier.
Another covers a sheet of names.
You hear water, wood and a distant bell.
The end credits do not take this work from them.

Osrics altes Register enthält Abfahrten: Osric's old register holds departures with struck-out entries. People were allowed to leave without leaving a substitute name.
Auf der letzten Seite steht Harrows Bitt: The last page holds Harrow's request for a one-time transfer during the storm flood. Osric wrote the introduction.
Neben seiner Unterschrift steht später:: Next to his signature, added later: extension without new authority. The addition is in the same ink as his private warning letters.
Die Glocke schlägt nicht nach Uhrzeit. I: The bell does not strike by the hour. Its old clapper bears the notch for the end of a reading of names.
Unter dem Sockel liegt die Anweisung: Na: Under the base lies the instruction: after the last name, ring once so the intake is closed.
Ein jüngerer Befehl des Rats verbietet g: A newer council order forbids exactly this single stroke. The ordinary tide strokes remain permitted.
Die Totenliste der Sturmflut ist älter a: The death list of the storm flood is older than Harrow's intake. The first names were confirmed by the bereaved.
Später kamen Lebende auf dieselben Bögen: Later the living were added to the same sheets. Instead of a date of death, they show a postponed departure.
Eine Kontrollspalte trennt Verlust, Aufe: A control column separates loss, residence and mere letter receipt. The later fair copy removed these distinctions.
Die Klippenmessung zeigt langsamen Druck: The cliff gauge shows pressure building slowly over years. An orderly transition leaves time for new dikes.
Die Notfalltafel warnt: Zerstörung des l: The emergency board warns: destroying the living bearer releases the held-back surge at once. The calculation assumes Harrow's sudden death.
Nach dem Leuchtfeuerkampf fällt die Lich: After the beacon fight the light shutter falls from the gauge strip. The stored height and today's outer water level are different lines.
Die Treppe hinauf in die Oberstraße: The stairs up to the High Street
Die Wandtabellen bewegen sich mit Harrow: The wall tables move with Harrow's breath. Lines appear between her fingers before the scribes copy them.
Unter der Amtskleidung liegt kein verbor: Beneath the robes of office lies no hidden book. The watermarks end on her skin, in the same places as on the pages.
Harrow says: "I took them in. Not wrote them down. Do not mistake the copy for the burden."
Die Schwellenmarke hat Platz für einen Z: The threshold mark has room for one witness. A second imprint can contest the entry of someone else's action.
Der gewählte Zollherr legt seinen Amtsst: The chosen customs lord sets his official stamp outside the watermark. He must witness each entry individually; a title alone is not enough.
Die Zeugenzeile bleibt lesbar, wenn Harr: The witness line stays legible when Harrow tries to hold on to an ability. The block lasts shorter, not not at all.
Nell hält Abstand vom offenen Wasserzeic: Nell keeps her distance from the open watermark. She can release single grasps; the sum of all names would be a different burden.
Osric liest ihr die Folgen vor: Wer das: Osric reads her the consequences: whoever takes over the register stays bound to place and names. A scribe can help, but cannot undo that.
Nell sagt: „Ich verstehe, dass ich dann: Nell says: "I understand that I would have to stay. You still can't just put me in." Her answer is recorded separately.
Nach dem Ende der Gegenwehr bleibt die S: After the resistance ends, the closing line stays open. The names remain bound until someone speaks a decision.
Die Ausgänge sind bezeichnet: Aufnahme,: The exits are marked: intake, destruction, handover. Two hands can share the burden only if both consent to the binding.
Auf dem trockenen Rand liegt Platz für e: On the dry edge lies room for a later renunciation. Permission for the Last Register is not yet a completed ritual.

The Customs Ghost drifts away like blotting paper.
Ein Mantel ohne Träger hebt einen Stempe: A coat without a wearer raises a stamp. Wherever it looks, the air turns into a form, and your name is already on it.
Der Zollgeist legt sich eine Akte an: +9: The Customs Ghost opens a file on itself: +9 Defence.
The Chief Customs Ghost drifts away like blotting paper.
Pegelknecht sinkt gegen den Zaun und rüh: The Tide Warden slumps against the fence and does not move again.
Zwei Männer in nassen Uniformen treten a: Two men in wet uniforms step out of the customs booth, hooks on long poles in their hands. Their faces are as smooth as the tide curve in the council.
Pegelvogt sinkt gegen den Zaun und rührt: The Tide Bailiff slumps against the fence and does not move again.
Das Licht erlischt. Im Rad bleibt ein Ma: The light goes out. In the wheel sits a man who has been running for forty years. He opens his eyes and asks whether the flood has come yet.
Tam fetches you off the bank with her boat. "The light strikes when you look into it," she says. "So next time, don't look."
Die Linse dreht sich zu dir, und der Lic: The lens turns towards you, and the cone of light stays on you. The beacon has grown arms of brass and glass. It guards the bell, and for forty years it has let no one ring it.
Eine Messingblende schiebt sich vor die: A brass shutter slides in front of the lens: +12 Defence.
Das Glas springt. Hinter der Linse sitzt: The glass cracks. Behind the lens a person sits in a treadwheel, emaciated, eyes closed. The wheel keeps turning, and the light grows furious.
Harrow fällt nicht. Sie setzt sich, wie: Harrow does not fall. She sits down the way one sits after a long shift. But the register on the walls keeps breathing, without her.
Du wachst auf der Kellertreppe auf. Jema: You wake on the cellar stairs. Someone has written your name on a slip of paper and put it in your hand. The handwriting is your own.
Wasser schießt durch die Fugen. Harrow h: Water shoots through the joints. Harrow raises her hand, and the flood obeys her, not you. You must get up before the stairs are under water. At low tide she will be waiting.
Harrow steht auf. Sie ist kleiner, als d: Harrow stands up. She is smaller than you thought, and the water in the joints rises when she breathes. "I saved this city from the sea," she says. "You want to take the rescue out of my hands. Then take it."
Harrow nimmt einen Namen auf. Die Wasser: Harrow takes in a name. The watermarks on her skin grow denser: +13 Defence.
Harrow sinkt auf die Knie, aber die Name: Harrow sinks to her knees, but the names on her skin rise up. They read themselves aloud.
Die Seiten fallen. Sie liegen auf dem na: The pages fall. They lie on the wet floor, and each bears only a name now, no command.
Die Regale lösen sich von den Wänden. Se: The shelves tear loose from the walls. Pages fly up, and from the pages comes a figure as large as the cellar, with a face of forty thousand names. Two Customs Ghosts stamp your every step.
The register begins to enter you. You feel your name grow heavier.
Wasser drückt durch die Fugen des Regist: Water presses through the joints of the Register Cellar, first ankle-deep, then knee-deep. You climb the stairs before the shelves float.

Der gewählte Ausgang bleibt bestehen. Ei: The chosen outcome stands. No ritual is performed automatically.

Ende von Kapitel 7: Zwei Hände bleiben: End of Chapter 7: Two Hands Remain
Die ersten Ausreisen werden ohne Ersatzn: The first departures are recorded without substitute names. In the keel room the Unlisted open an ordinary guest list, which may also stay empty.
Tam fährt die Fähre mit ihrer eigenen St: Tam steers the ferry with her own voice. Her stolen badge lies in a bowl beside the surrendered keys.
Nell geht an den Tafeln vorbei, ohne ein: Nell walks past the boards without having to take a name away. You carry the burden, but you ask no thanks of her for it.
Osric veröffentlicht die erste Einleitun: Osric publishes the first introduction together with his later warnings. He lets no one print the second part as an excuse for the first.
Der Rat verliert das Recht, Menschen dur: The council loses the right to hold people by their entries. The seven offices remain bound to render account, even where their holders do not yet grasp their own change.
Ein Brief erreicht Kettlegate mit einer: A letter reaches Kettlegate with a copy of the old dispatch note from Case 9. Your name on that paper explains a connection, not all the city's riddles.
Nach Wexmoor geht die Nachricht, dass ei: Word goes to Wexmoor that a name can be released without a new binding. How the city deals with it remains bound to the decisions it has already made.
In Dunscar wird die Hafenmeldung zwische: In Dunscar the harbour report is placed between two timetables. No one has to strike an earlier debt from the duty log for it.
Calderwick erhält den Abdruck der aufgeh: Calderwick receives the imprint of the lifted block. The printers check the missing powers before they set a new word for freedom.
In Briarholt wird die Hafenregel neben d: In Briarholt the harbour rule is filed beside the declarations on treatment. What was chosen there stands; a distant outcome heals no unasked-for taking.
Das Wasser nimmt die unteren Gassen, wäh: The water takes the lower lanes while the prepared boats collect the last residents. The Unlisted carry out no name checks at the rescue planks.
Tam zählt Plätze und fährt dieselbe Stre: Tam counts seats and runs the same route until no signal comes from the pier. Her voice grows hoarse, but the last trip is not embellished into a legend.
Nell sitzt mit ihrer Mütze im trockenen: Nell sits in the dry boat with her cap and leaves every name untouched. You have renounced the ascension and help with the landing, without seeing it as a lesser task.
Osric hält die Liste der Toten über dem: Osric holds the list of the dead above the water. Later he adds Harrow's name, leaving out neither her rescue back then nor her rule afterwards.
Die Zollherren legen ihre Amtszeichen in: The customs lords drop their badges of office into a bucket on the High Street. The bucket keeps metal, not authority over the rescued.
Kettlegate liest von der überfluteten Mü: Kettlegate reads of the flooded estuary and the letter that brought your name there. The earlier city receives no new explanation for everything that happened to it.
Wexmoor schickt eine knappe Anleitung zu: Wexmoor sends brief instructions for drying wood and paper. The reply demands neither a return nor a change to the ending chosen there.
In Dunscar steht die Räumung unter den u: In Dunscar the evacuation is listed under the interrupted connections. One free line is reserved for news from survivors.
Calderwick druckt zuerst die sicheren An: Calderwick first prints the safe moorings, then the council's speeches. It is an order that, this time, no one in the harbour may vote on.
Briarholt erhält eine Liste benötigter D: Briarholt receives a list of needed blankets and ordinary remedies. No one orders a treatment that replaces consent with calm.
Der Hafen bleibt trocken, aber die neue: The harbour stays dry, but the new bearer does not sit in a free place. The Unlisted keep the keel room open and demand daily insight into the releases.
Tam bringt Nell Nachrichten von Orten au: Tam brings Nell news from places beyond the register line. She reads it aloud instead of calling the enclosed distance a gift.
Nell spricht jeden Namen mit dir durch u: Nell goes through every name with you and strikes the finished line herself. You stay her scribe; her consent does not make the burden fit for her age, nor your presence dispensable.
Osric erklärt das alte Verfahren nun bei: Osric now explains the old procedure with the door open. He insists that Nell's later objection must be heard as well.
Der Rat darf keine neuen Namen ohne geso: The council may add no new names without separate consent. Its lost privilege is not reintroduced as fatherly supervision over Nell.
Kettlegate erhält die Nachricht eines We: Kettlegate receives news of a change, not of a redemption. The letter from Case 9 stays in the evidence set so the start of the chain remains legible.
Wexmoor hört, dass eine Last auf ein Kin: Wexmoor hears that a burden passed to a child. The reply is short and uncomfortable, and you do not file it with the settled letters.
Dunscar verlangt im Fahrplan keine Namen: Dunscar asks for no travellers' names from the harbour register in its timetable. Single systems can separate, even if their earlier connections still have effect.
Calderwick bittet um Abdrucke jeder künf: Calderwick asks for prints of every future release rule. You send the first version and leave room for objections instead of claiming a final order.
Briarholt schickt die Form einer widerru: Briarholt sends the form of a revocable declaration. You lay it beside Nell's hand, though you do not yet know how a later revocation could be carried.
Die Stadt hat zwei Träger und keinen neu: The city has two bearers and no new compulsion to enter. In the keel room the Unlisted keep asking about every name that appears without consent.
Tam legt zwei Nachrichtenmappen an dense: Tam lays two message folders on the same table. She refuses to let one answer count automatically for both.
Nell zählt zwei ruhende Hände und dann i: Nell counts two resting hands and then her free exit. You both stay in Varrowmouth and let her go, without demanding her gift as substitute service.
Osric schreibt beide Zustimmungen auf ve: Osric writes both consents on separate sheets. He has learned that a shared heading hides different people too easily.
Der Rat muss jeder von euch gestellten F: The council must answer each question either of you asks separately. The seven offices find this duplication tiresome, which is no longer an objection.
Kettlegate erhält zwei Unterschriften un: Kettlegate receives two signatures under the same message. The old letter with your names is not retroactively declared your consent.
Wexmoor liest, dass keiner von euch die: Wexmoor reads that neither of you chose the last step. The message names no lack of courage, only the consequences of a conscious binding.
Dunscar vermerkt zwei Personen am selben: Dunscar notes two persons at the same endpoint. The city's earlier history stays beside it, unabridged.
Calderwick druckt die beiden Sichtweisen: Calderwick prints the two points of view in separate columns. Equal column width does not make them an equal memory.
Briarholt erhält euren Bericht über geme: Briarholt receives your report on jointly carried limits. The city must keep answering for the decisions it has already made.
Spieler 1 trägt die Namen, Spieler 2 häl: Player 1 carries the names, Player 2 keeps the remaining evidence freely accessible. The shared journey does not end with an equal burden.
Spieler 2 schreibt die Schlusszeile, wäh: Player 2 writes the closing line while Player 1 witnesses the free exit. No one may later rename the bearer to the first player out of habit.
Du merkst dir die Namen, die dein Gegenü: You remember the names your partner cannot carry today. That is an arrangement for this watch, not an eternal precedence.
Du übernimmst die Liste erst, als die Üb: You take over the list only once the handover has been spoken. Staying together does not mean always having to answer at the same time.
Ein Stück der großen Linse, noch warm. W: A piece of the great lens, still warm. Whoever looks through it sees the waterline that was kept silent for forty years.
Ein schlichter Ring aus Zinn, in den kei: A plain pewter ring with no name engraved. In the register it was the only object without an entry.
